high_level_description: This image is a promotional graphic celebrating Lionel Messi's iconic solo goal against CF Montréal, which has been nominated for the MLS Goal of the Year award. The main focus is on a photograph of Lionel Messi, who is wearing a pink jersey with "Messi" written on the back. He is captured in a moment of celebration, raising his right fist in triumph. His left arm is adorned with tattoos, including a prominent floral design.
